deliberateNativeDifferences: The Web prototype does not imitate iOS camera, Photos, location, or microphone permission sheets; it renders only the app-owned state before the explicit action and after control returns.
The Web prototype does not imitate UIActivityViewController, AirDrop targets, or third-party destinations.

When payload preparation reaches ready, the Web prototype ends the app-owned popover immediately; the subsequently presented system activity controller is a documented text boundary rather than another simulated screen.
The Viewer toolbar uses the exact recorded share-network and trash template vectors; other HTML icons remain optical analogues whose recorded SF Symbol identities apply only to their native rows.
The generic review frame is a viewport aid and not physical-device evidence.
The iCloud progress and local-integrity fixtures simulate visible states only; they do not download, hash, parse proof data, or establish a credential verdict.
Haptics, PhotoKit, AVPlayer, signing, ZIP generation, cancellation at the resource layer, and temporary-file cleanup require native tests.

approval.composition: Each task slice retains its independently recorded owner approval; merging TAP-0008-r2 into the current source does not revise TAP-0009-r1 or TAP-0081-r3.
